# Freebox Player Pop

Control Freebox Player Pop media through Google Cast, or remote keys and app links through Android TV Remote v2, via Muse Home Link, using whichever local service is actually available. A Freebox router/server is not the Player Pop, and Cast and Remote v2 are separate services with separate capabilities: neither is inferred from the other. Cast media/status/volume is delegated to the shared gadget-google-cast skill.
